model_metadata.purpose: Auxiliary post-incident severity ranking for reported incidents
model_metadata.architecture: Dense(16) -> BN -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Dense(8) -> BN -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Dense(1)
model_metadata.optimiser: Adam, learning rate 0.005, weight decay 0.0001, full batch
model_metadata.early_stopping: validation loss, patience 20, at most 300 epochs, best-epoch weights restored

loss_formulation.pos_weight_formula: w = N_neg / N_pos of the fitting part
loss_formulation.loss_mathematical_formula: L(z, y) = (1 - y) * softplus(z) + w * y * softplus(-z)

protocol.inner_split: fitting / validation / calibration = 70 / 15 / 15 within each training part, stratified
protocol.stratification: Stratified by the severe-harm label (FATAL > 0 or INJURE > 0)

baselines.cause_only: severe rate of each cause in the training part
baselines.logistic_regression: same 11 inputs, unweighted, ridge 0.01 (intercept unpenalised), fitted on the training part
baselines.prior: training-part prevalence given to every test incident (Brier only)

protocol.interval_method: corrected repeated k-fold t interval (Nadeau and Bengio, 2003), 49 df

final_model.note: No separate test set; the cross-validation summary is the performance estimate for this procedure.

all_causes_joint_group.note: Mean over 50 test folds of the AUC drop averaged over 10 shuffles per fold.

log_accident_psig.note: Mean over 50 test folds of the AUC drop averaged over 10 shuffles per fold.

log_release_mcf.note: Mean over 50 test folds of the AUC drop averaged over 10 shuffles per fold.

location_type_group.note: Mean over 50 test folds of the AUC drop averaged over 10 shuffles per fold.

permutation_methodological_notes.explanation: Shuffling one cause indicator on its own creates rows with two causes, so the joint cause group is the measure used for cause importance.
